summary.en: Merlin Ventures is the venture arm of Merlin Group, a US-Israeli cybersecurity investor that built out its Israel team in early 2021 and closed an oversubscribed ~$75M fund in 2025. It backs Israeli cyber startups for US/global expansion; its earlier vehicles produced six exits including Talon and Dig Security (both to Palo Alto Networks), Veriti (Check Point) and InfoSec Global (Keyfactor).

summary.en: S Ventures is the $100M corporate venture fund launched in 2022 by Israeli-founded cybersecurity firm SentinelOne. It invests across all stages (typically $1M–$5M checks) in security, data and AI companies, with a dedicated Israel investment lead (Iren Reznikov) sourcing local startups. Israeli portfolio includes Torq and Laminar (later acquired by Rubrik).
